findings.evidence: `Representative.lean:13,15` says “topological group,” and `TensorProduct.lean:13` says “same group”; the declaration contexts at `Representative.lean:95`, `TensorProduct.lean:79`, `Conjugate.lean:187`, and `Transport.lean:44` require only `Monoid G` and `TopologicalSpace G`.
findings.fix: Replace the group-specific scope descriptions with “a monoid equipped with a topology” (not “topological monoid,” which could imply continuous multiplication), while retaining compact-group references only as downstream motivation.
findings.issue: The new module docs describe `G` as a “topological group” or “group,” although every declaration assumes only `[Monoid G] [TopologicalSpace G]`, without inverses or continuity of multiplication.

summary: The module documentation understates the generality of the new API by repeatedly describing it as group-specific.
